text:
Ana (Marketing): Heads-up — planning release announce Thurs 09:00 PT. Need final changelog bullets, staging docs links, and confirmation on canary window. Also want to lock webinar slot the following Tue 10:00 PT. @Matt @Olivia @Devon can you confirm?

Matt (Eng): I can finish changelog today. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/pull/482. Will add short bullets for Dedicated + Optimize changes. For canary I'd prefer a late window to avoid traffic.

Devon (PM): Ops asked for later window — canary 21:00 PT -> 00:00 PT works? That lines up with low traffic in prod. Is that OK for marketing timing?

Olivia (Docs): Staging docs are up: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03. I'll add a "What's new" and migration notes by EOD once changelog is final. Need Matt's bullets.

Sam (Sales): For inbound routing: we'll route high-intent signups to enterprise-sales@redwood.ai and tag them in Zendesk with `release:2026-03`. Webinar signups should auto-create a prospect task for AEs. I can draft the routing playbook.

Matt (Eng): Added changelog bullets in the PR: `- improved batching heuristics reducing cost ~0.5x for short sequences`, `- rolling fallback to quantized variants on memory pressure`, `- KV cache fixes to reduce tail latency`. Also note: embeddings index migration behind a feature flag in PR #489.

Ana (Marketing): :thumbsup: Olivia — once the staging link is final we’ll put it in the blog and release note. Devon — need a one-sentence rollback policy to include in the announcement.

Devon (PM): Rollback blurb: "We will monitor model and routing health during rollout and automatically revert to the last healthy variant if regressions are detected." Keep it short.

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: `job/2026-03-release-canary` -> start at 2101299000 (Thu 21:00 PT). Status: pending.

Matt (Eng): Quick FYI — please do not call the embeddings migration by default. The flag is off by default in the canary. We'll only flip it after QA signoff.

Olivia (Docs): Copy — I'll only publish the migration guide after you flip the flag. ETA: I'll ping here when the staging link is final and give the exact URL.

Sam (Sales): I'll create the lead-routing doc and share the link in this thread by EOD.

Ana (Marketing): Thanks all. Plan for me: finish blog draft with Matt's bullets and Devon's rollback blurb once Olivia confirms staging URL. I'll hold webinar invites until speakers confirmed (need two AEs + eng speaker). Will follow up with a quick checklist for assets (blog, docs, screenshots, webinar slide deck).

Olivia (Docs): Ping here when PR is merged and I'll cut the final docs URL.

Matt (Eng): Merged changelog PR and flagged the migration as feature-flagged. PRs: #482, #489.

Ana (Marketing): Perfect — I'll schedule the publish for Thurs 09:00 PT and confirm the canary window with Ops (21:00 PT). Will post final links here when live.

Sam (Sales): Shared lead-routing doc: https://wiki.redwood.ai/sales/release-2026-03-routing — ETA comments by EOD.

Olivia (Docs): Staging URL updated to final: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03. Ready to link.

Ana (Marketing): All set. Thanks everyone! :tada:
